Given what I've just heard, here's what I'm considering before I finalize the temporary arrangement:

1. Casey will continue as direct client liaison for Northstar, but all handoffs will be documented using a single agreed template (we'll define it today) rather than scattered across email and chat.
2. The recurring coordination meeting will be set for 15:00–15:30, and Casey will not be required to attend more than two live coordination meetings per week.
3. Morgan is currently not attending the weekly coordination meeting. Given the relationship tension Ravi observed and Morgan's explicit request not to be scheduled one-to-one with Casey, I will not mandate any direct Casey-Morgan meeting as part of this temporary plan. Instead, I'll facilitate a structured repair conversation separately, and Ravi can serve as an intermediary for handoff communication in the interim if needed.
4. The client-contact plan will be reviewed and finalized before next week's client status call.
